name: Vegas Casino Environment
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'set -e; chmod +x .devcontainer/post_create.sh && chmod +x codespace/configuration/init.sh && chmod +x codespace/deployment.sh && echo "Running post_create.sh..." && .devcontainer/post_create.sh && echo "Running init.sh..." && codespace/configuration/init.sh && echo "Running deployment.sh..." && codespace/deployment.sh'

DYNATRACE_API_TOKEN.description: Dynatrace access token with these permissions: `apiTokens.read` & `apiTokens.write`

DYNATRACE_PLATFORM_TOKEN.description: Dynatrace platform token with permission `davis-copilot:conversations:execute`. This permission must be granted via IAM: create (or reuse) a policy containing the statement `ALLOW davis-copilot:conversations:execute;`, bind it to a group, and assign your user to that group (see docs/getting-started.md for the step-by-step).
